text:
Alex: heads up — ACME SI is moving our marketplace listing through their security gate. they asked for SOC2 report, latest pentest summary, and answers to their 30-question vendor questionnaire. timeline: want everything by EOD next tuesday. can we triage?
Maria: ok — do we know if they need the full SOC2 attestation PDF or just the summary + control mapping?
Sam: they usually accept the summary + control mapping + signed attestation letter from our security lead. full PDF only if legal asks.
Alex: @Maria can you confirm whether the SOC we have includes the marketplace domain (redwood-inference.com) in scope?
Maria: double-checking now. looks like SOC covers platform infra and data flows, but marketplace listing artifacts live under a partner registry scope we didn't explicitly list. that might require a short attestation addendum from SecOps.
PJordan: if we need to produce an addendum, security will need the scope statement + CISO sign-off. estimate 2-3 business days.
Sam: for pentest — we have the last vendor report from 2025-07. they want a summary and remediation status. I can produce a 1-pager with vuln counts + open/closed status.
Alex: great. also they asked for artifact transfer mechanics — presigned links preferred. who owns generating and TTL?
Maria: ops can generate S3 presigns to our restricted evidence bucket. suggest 7-day TTL. share with SI via one-time access email.
Sam: example command for presign (ops run):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/ACME/2026-03-15/soc-summary.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
PJordan: make sure to set bucket-level policy to block public ACLs and log access. we should attach an HMAC scope note in the email.
Alex: questionnaire — they asked about patch cadences, encryption in transit & at rest, KMS/HSM usage, and model artifact retention. who will draft answers?
Sam: I can draft first pass for infra + runtime. @Maria you do compliance bits (controls mapping + attestation). PJordan you do security ops/HSM answers.
Maria: noted. I'll also include a short cover note explaining scope caveat (marketplace registry objects not in SOC scope) and propose the attestation addendum path.
PJordan: quick flag — if we reference HSM or customer-managed keys in answers, product/legal want to sign off on marketing wording. avoid implying new features.
Alex: good call. also ACME wants to sync on joint announcement timing once listing is live. they want a co-branded blurb. we'll hold announcement until evidence is accepted and listing is published.
Sam: action items: 1) Sam: pentest 1-pager by Thu EOD. 2) Maria: control mapping + SOC scope note + presign request by Fri. 3) PJordan: HSM/KMS wording + bucket policy checklist by Fri. 4) Alex: coordinate the co-announcement template and review with comms.
qa-bot: reminder: attach ticket numbers and deploy IDs to any artifacts. use ticket #PRT-1428 in filenames.
Alex: thanks team. if anyone hits blockers ping me in thread and I'll escalate to Legal/Security. :thumbsup:
